title: Marginalia
rule: Page 01 reprinted small with an annotator's pencil notes pointing to the evidence for each event.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
made: page 01's own master (films/sources/99-ways/masters/01-template.png: the Rothstein 1937 agent and office, Rothstein tavern clock, ANRC 1922 key photo-cutouts) reprinted at 0.56 as a photographic print with a white border, one gentle neutral grade, laid 0.8 degrees askew with a cast shadow on the LoC 1934 sheet

HANDMADE pencil: notes in the shared pen hand drawn in graphite grey (62,62,70), broken by the sheet's own tooth (high-pass of the LoC sheet grain); pencil rings round each piece of evidence on the print and bowed leaders with arrowheads from each note (one leader bent along a gutter to reach the clock)
seven notes: a header 'p. 01, read again with a pencil: where does each event show?', notes E0-E5 each labelled with its event id, and a closing summary of the outcome

events.E0: note E0 (top left): rings on P1's memo and P3's shut cupboard
events.E1: note E1 (left): ring on P4's question balloon at the TICKET OFFICE glass
events.E2: note E2 (right): ring on P5's clock at 4:10
events.E3: note E3 (right): ring on P6's emptied window
events.E4: note E4 (left): ring on P7's key on its hook, tag SERVICE
events.E5: note E5 (bottom): rings on P8's pencil at the chin, the key still on its hook and the SERVICE card

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: the annotator works through the reprint: the bare print first, then one pencil note with its rings and leaders per event, E0 to E5, and last the summary
beat_frames: b07: + E5 and the summary (= the page)

self_check.check: A reader finds a note pointing to every event E0-E5 -> six labelled notes, each with a leader ending in a pencil ring on page 01's evidence
self_check.evidence: measured (size, word lists) and perceptually judged from the full-size page by the maker; blind reading pending

weaknesses: at 0.56 the reprinted page 01's own memo and key-tag lettering is tiny; the notes quote it so it need not be read there
the reprint is page 01's digital master scaled, not a rephotographed print; the 'photographic print' is the border, grade, tilt and shadow
the E0 leaders and the E5 leaders cross other panels of the reprint on their way to the evidence
page 01 never shows the stranger; the E1 note says so instead of pointing to her
the pencil is the shared pen hand in grey with paper tooth, not a separate pencil hand
